# Pari (parileads.com)

> Verified lead generation and marketing for growing businesses. Pari researches leads by hand, verifies the decision maker, email and phone before delivery, and runs marketing in five areas: social media, outreach, ads, sales support, and websites with SEO. Run by Lee Thompson from Clear Lake, Iowa, working with businesses across the United States.

Leads researched for a client go to that client only and are never resold. On the main plan, clients pay only for verified clients: a fee is due when a delivered lead becomes the client's paying customer. Other payment plans are available. Clients own their website, accounts, content and data. Pari does not use bought lists, bulk spam, robocalls or fake reviews.

## Pages
- [Home](https://parileads.com/): overview, the research behind the approach, how it works
- [Lead generation](https://parileads.com/lead-generation/): what a verified lead includes, the four-step research process, pricing approach
- [Marketing](https://parileads.com/marketing/): social media, outreach, ads, sales, websites and SEO, each with a cited statistic
- [About](https://parileads.com/about/): Lee Thompson, background and commitments
- [FAQ](https://parileads.com/faq/): verification, lead sources, pricing, contracts, spam and calling rules, timelines
- [Contact](https://parileads.com/contact/): book a call, phone 641-596-0111, hello@parileads.com
